title: Kitchen knife skills
description: Prepare ingredients safely and consistently by choosing suitable cuts, controlling the knife, and keeping the work surface stable.
oneStarDescription: Set up a stable cutting board and demonstrate a safe grip and guiding-hand position while cutting one soft ingredient into pieces.
twoStarDescription: Prepare two different ingredients with reasonably even slices and cubes, with pieces cooking or serving consistently.
threeStarDescription: Prepare a small meal’s ingredients using at least three suitable cut types while keeping the work area organised and safe.

title: Pan-searing and browning
description: Use surface dryness, pan heat, spacing, and timing to create even browning while cooking food to an appropriate doneness. Steak is an example for practice, not a separate skill.
oneStarDescription: Brown a suitable food item in a pan without crowding it and identify the visual signs of a properly browned surface.
twoStarDescription: Repeat the technique with more even browning and explain how pan heat, moisture, and crowding affected the outcome.
threeStarDescription: Cook a suitable item to a stated doneness using a reliable timing or thermometer method and allow an appropriate rest where relevant.

title: Personal budgeting and saving
description: Set practical money goals, map income and expenses, make a usable budget, and review it to support deliberate saving decisions. This is personal financial capability, not business budget management.
oneStarDescription: Record income and expenses for a chosen period and group them into a small number of understandable categories.
twoStarDescription: Build a monthly plan that accounts for known expenses, sets a realistic goal, and leaves any shortfall or surplus visible.
threeStarDescription: Review actual spending against a budget for at least two periods, explain the main deviations, and adjust the plan or savings target.

title: Make sauces and dressings
description: Build flavour and control consistency in simple cold dressings and hot sauces, using tasting and adjustment rather than following a single recipe mechanically.
oneStarDescription: Prepare a simple dressing with balanced acidity, fat, and seasoning, then adjust it after tasting.
twoStarDescription: Prepare a simple gravy or pan sauce with no obvious lumps and a consistency appropriate to the dish.
threeStarDescription: Prepare either a cold dressing or hot sauce from a basic formula and make two deliberate adjustments to achieve the intended flavour and consistency.

title: Make stock and broth
description: Extract flavour from suitable ingredients with controlled simmering, then strain, cool, and store the liquid safely for later cooking.
oneStarDescription: Prepare a simple stock or broth using a clear method and strain it without leaving unwanted solids.
twoStarDescription: Produce a repeatable result by maintaining a gentle simmer and explaining how time and ingredients affect flavour and clarity.
threeStarDescription: Prepare stock for a planned dish, evaluate its flavour, and cool and store leftovers according to reliable food-safety guidance.

title: Understand interest costs
description: Understand how interest affects borrowing costs and compare the cost of credit using the actual terms and repayment assumptions.
oneStarDescription: Identify the interest rate, relevant fees, repayment period, and total amount repayable in a clearly described example.
twoStarDescription: Calculate or verify the total cost for two simple borrowing scenarios using the provided rates, fees, and repayment assumptions.
threeStarDescription: Compare two credit examples with different rates, fees, or terms and explain how each change affects the total paid and repayment burden.

title: Accurate throwing
description: Learn to direct a throw by coordinating stance, release, force and follow-through rather than relying on strength alone.
oneStarDescription: Land a soft object inside a broad target from a comfortable short distance on 5 of 10 attempts.
twoStarDescription: Hit two broad targets at different distances, scoring at least 6 of 10 attempts at each.
threeStarDescription: Choose an appropriate throw for two different target locations and complete 8 of 10 attempts within the agreed target zones.

title: Balance and weight transfer
description: Develop stable posture and controlled weight shifts while standing, stepping and changing direction.
oneStarDescription: Hold a comfortable single-leg or split-stance position for 10 seconds on each side, repeating twice beside a stable support.
twoStarDescription: Complete five slow weight shifts in different directions, returning to a stable stance after each without grabbing support.
threeStarDescription: Perform a short sequence of stepping, pausing and turning in both directions with controlled stops and no loss of balance.

title: Ball dribbling and control
description: Maintain control of a ball while keeping it moving with repeated hand, foot or implement contacts appropriate to the chosen activity.
oneStarDescription: Maintain 10 consecutive controlled contacts with a ball in place or along a short straight path.
twoStarDescription: Guide the ball through a line of five wide-spaced markers without losing control more than once.
threeStarDescription: Complete a short slalom that includes two deliberate changes of direction and one tempo change while retaining control.

title: Ballroom standard dance foundations
description: Practise the posture, frame, basic steps and controlled movement used in standard ballroom dance such as waltz or tango.
oneStarDescription: Practise a beginner posture/frame and one simple step pattern from a chosen standard dance, solo or with a consenting partner.
twoStarDescription: Link two beginner patterns while maintaining a comfortable frame, direction and spacing.
threeStarDescription: Perform a short phrase to music with controlled direction changes, timing and awareness of other dancers.

title: Boogie-woogie dancing
description: Learn the rhythmic footwork, bounce and improvised partner interaction characteristic of boogie-woogie dance.
oneStarDescription: Practise the beginner rhythm and basic step pattern to suitable music for three short repetitions.
twoStarDescription: Add two simple footwork variations while maintaining the shared rhythm and personal balance.
threeStarDescription: Dance a short improvised sequence with a consenting partner, maintaining timing, comfortable connection and space awareness.

title: Breaking foundations
description: Explore beginner top-rock footwork, rhythm, levels and safe transitions as an entry point to breaking culture and movement.
oneStarDescription: Learn and repeat a short beginner top-rock pattern while staying upright and keeping time with music.
twoStarDescription: Connect two taught standing footwork patterns with a clear transition and repeat the combination twice.
threeStarDescription: Create a short beginner round combining learned standing footwork and a personal variation, maintaining control and awareness of space.

title: Catching with control
description: Track and receive a moving object by preparing the hands or an appropriate body position and adjusting to its path.
oneStarDescription: Catch a large soft ball from a partner at a short distance on at least 5 of 10 gentle throws.
twoStarDescription: Catch a soft ball arriving at three comfortable heights or directions on at least 7 of 10 attempts.
threeStarDescription: Move between two marked positions and catch 8 of 10 gentle throws without entering another person’s space.

title: Contemporary dance foundations
description: Explore grounded movement, balance, controlled changes of level and expressive short sequences characteristic of contemporary dance.
oneStarDescription: Create and repeat a short sequence of three standing shapes with deliberate weight shifts and pauses.
twoStarDescription: Link a standing movement, a lower-level movement and a controlled return to standing on a suitable surface.
threeStarDescription: Create and perform a 20–30-second phrase using a repeated motif and two changes of direction or level.

title: Kicking with control
description: Direct a stationary or gently moving ball using controlled contact, aiming and adjustment of force.
oneStarDescription: Send a stationary soft ball into a broad target area from a short distance on 5 of 10 attempts.
twoStarDescription: Pass to two target zones at different distances, reaching the intended zone on 6 of 10 attempts.
threeStarDescription: Complete a sequence of five controlled passes with a partner while moving through an open marked area.

title: Cross-country skiing basics
description: Learn the foundational balance, glide, propulsion and speed-control skills needed to move on cross-country skis on beginner terrain.
oneStarDescription: With a beginner instructor or experienced guide, put on fitted equipment, stand and take short steps on flat beginner terrain.
twoStarDescription: On a groomed beginner trail, link short controlled glides with a taught classic stride or beginner technique, then stop as instructed.
threeStarDescription: Complete a short groomed beginner loop with controlled movement, stopping and turns appropriate to the lesson, following trail etiquette.

title: Cycling confidently and safely
description: Develop starting, stopping, steering, signalling, route awareness and simple bicycle checks for everyday riding.
oneStarDescription: In a traffic-free area, start, ride a straight line, make a broad turn and stop predictably on five consecutive attempts.
twoStarDescription: On a quiet separated route, scan behind when appropriate, signal clearly where safe and manage simple gear changes.
threeStarDescription: Plan and ride a route appropriate to current ability, checking the bicycle, surface, weather and local rules before starting.

title: Dance rhythm and basic steps
description: Develop timing, weight changes and short repeatable movement sequences that can serve as a foundation for learning a specific dance style.
oneStarDescription: Clap or step to a steady musical pulse for 30 seconds and restart on the beat after one deliberate pause.
twoStarDescription: Learn and repeat a simple 4–8-count step sequence to music three times with broadly consistent timing.
threeStarDescription: Perform a familiar short sequence to two pieces with different tempos or accents, adjusting movement without losing the core rhythm.

title: Disco dance foundations
description: Practise energetic, rhythm-led disco dance movements using basic steps, controlled arm/body actions and beginner turns within personal ability.
oneStarDescription: Learn a short beginner disco phrase with two simple steps and a clear arm pattern.
twoStarDescription: Repeat a short phrase with one controlled direction change and a simple turn appropriate to ability.
threeStarDescription: Perform a short phrase with two musical accents and adapt its energy to the music without losing control.

title: Gymnastics movement foundations
description: Develop foundational body shapes, controlled transitions, balance and safe landings as preparation for recreational gymnastics.
oneStarDescription: Under qualified supervision, demonstrate a small set of basic static shapes and controlled two-foot landings on an appropriate mat.
twoStarDescription: Under supervision, link a short beginner sequence of taught shapes, steps and balances with controlled pauses.
threeStarDescription: Demonstrate a short individual beginner sequence selected by a qualified coach, including controlled transitions and stable finishes.

title: Hiking and trail preparation
description: Plan and complete walks on suitable outdoor routes by matching the route to ability, checking conditions and carrying appropriate essentials.
oneStarDescription: Choose a familiar short route, check the forecast, footwear and water needs, and tell someone the planned route when appropriate.
twoStarDescription: Complete a suitable marked trail, track progress and adjust pace or breaks to keep the outing comfortable.
threeStarDescription: Create a route plan with expected timing, navigation backup, essentials, a turnaround point and a plan for changing conditions.

title: Hip-hop dance foundations
description: Learn groove, basic bounce, isolations and short rhythmic combinations within hip-hop dance practice.
oneStarDescription: Perform a simple bounce/groove pattern for 30 seconds to music and stop/start on a clear cue.
twoStarDescription: Link three taught foundation movements into a short combination and repeat it twice in time with music.
threeStarDescription: Perform a short combination and adapt its timing or energy to a different section of the music while keeping the movement controlled.

title: Hopping and rhythmic skipping
description: Practise single-leg hops and alternating skipping patterns with rhythm, spatial control and balanced transitions.
oneStarDescription: Complete five small hops on a comfortable side, then repeat on the other side, with pauses as needed.
twoStarDescription: Move through four ground markers using a chosen hop or skip pattern without stepping outside the practice lane.
threeStarDescription: Combine hopping and skipping across a short marked sequence, changing pattern at two clear cues without losing control.

title: Jazz dance foundations
description: Practise jazz-walks, isolations, kicks or turns at a beginner level, combining clean shapes with musical timing.
oneStarDescription: Practise two beginner jazz movements separately with control and appropriate range of motion.
twoStarDescription: Combine three taught movements into an 8-count phrase and repeat it with consistent timing.
threeStarDescription: Perform a short phrase and deliberately accent two musical cues while maintaining alignment and controlled finishes.

title: Jumping and landing with control
description: Develop controlled take-off and landing for simple jumps in place and over low ground markers.
oneStarDescription: Perform five small two-foot jumps in place, holding a balanced landing after each.
twoStarDescription: Jump over a low flat marker in two directions and hold a stable landing for two seconds on 4 of 5 attempts.
threeStarDescription: Complete a short sequence of low jumps with changes of direction and stable pauses, without clipping markers or losing balance.

title: Latin ballroom dance foundations
description: Develop timing, weight transfer, posture and basic partner awareness across beginner Latin ballroom dance practice.
oneStarDescription: Practise a beginner rhythm pattern and basic steps from one chosen Latin ballroom dance with a qualified or reliable beginner lesson.
twoStarDescription: Combine two basic step patterns and a direction change while maintaining posture and floor awareness.
threeStarDescription: Perform a short sequence of learned figures to music, keeping timing and partner/floor awareness across transitions.

title: Mountain biking fundamentals
description: Develop controlled bike handling on suitable off-road trails, including body position, braking, surface awareness and choosing a safe line.
oneStarDescription: Check bike condition and protective equipment, then ride a broad, gentle, traffic-free track at a pace where stopping is easy.
twoStarDescription: Ride a beginner-rated trail with small surface changes and broad turns while braking before obstacles and remaining in control.
threeStarDescription: Complete an appropriate marked route, explaining the chosen line around several non-technical obstacles and yielding safely to others.

title: Paddling basics
description: Practise basic paddle strokes, steering and stopping in a suitable small craft while learning to prepare for a safe supervised outing.
oneStarDescription: Identify the craft’s basic safety equipment, fit a suitable life jacket and practise the basic paddle movement on land or under instruction.
twoStarDescription: With appropriate supervision on calm sheltered water, paddle a short route, turn both ways and stop on instruction.
threeStarDescription: Prepare a short route with weather and water-condition checks, suitable equipment, a partner/group and a communication plan, then complete it under appropriate supervision.
category_es: Agua y habilidades al aire libre

title: Pilates foundations
description: Build a beginner practice around controlled movement, breathing, attention and alignment in an appropriate Pilates class or guided routine.
oneStarDescription: Complete an introductory guided session and identify how breathing, attention and controlled movement are used in the chosen exercises.
twoStarDescription: Perform a short beginner mat sequence with controlled transitions and the breathing cues taught by the instructor.
threeStarDescription: Complete a familiar beginner sequence with consistent control, describe two technique cues that help, and identify when an exercise should be modified.

title: Roller-skating fundamentals
description: Learn a stable stance, controlled rolling, turning and stopping on roller skates or inline skates before attempting speed or tricks.
oneStarDescription: On flat, traffic-free ground, practise a stable stance, short glides and a taught beginner stop while wearing protective gear.
twoStarDescription: Follow a wide figure-eight or similar marked path and stop at two planned points without colliding or entering another person’s path.
threeStarDescription: Complete a simple marked course with turns, slowdowns and stops while scanning the surface and yielding to others.

title: Running and pacing
description: Practise relaxed running or run-walk intervals with a controlled pace and a repeatable routine rather than chasing speed.
oneStarDescription: Complete a comfortable 10-minute session alternating short easy runs and walking, adjusting intervals before form breaks down.
twoStarDescription: Complete a 15-minute easy run or run-walk session while maintaining a pace that allows short sentences and finishing in control.
threeStarDescription: Plan a comfortable 20–30-minute run-walk session, adjust pace to route and conditions, and note what pacing pattern felt sustainable.

title: Salsa dancing
description: Learn the timing, basic steps, direction changes and partner communication that make salsa a recognisable social dance practice.
oneStarDescription: Perform a basic salsa step pattern to music for three short repetitions while keeping a steady count.
twoStarDescription: Practise a simple turn or direction change, solo or with a consenting partner, while maintaining timing and comfortable spacing.
threeStarDescription: Combine a basic step, a turn and a direction change into a short sequence to music, adjusting to the partner and floor space.

title: Sportsmanship and fair play
description: Apply shared rules honestly, communicate respectfully and handle disagreements constructively in recreational sport or games.
oneStarDescription: Before a recreational game, explain three key rules and apply them honestly during play.
twoStarDescription: During a game, resolve one rules disagreement by pausing, explaining the concern calmly and using an agreed rule or neutral decision method.
threeStarDescription: Help a group agree on fair rules and inclusive participation, then reflect on whether the game followed those agreements.
category_es: Habilidades sociales a través del deporte

title: Striking an object with control
description: Practise contacting a moving or stationary object with a hand or appropriate implement and directing its path deliberately.
oneStarDescription: Strike a stationary soft ball or suspended target gently on 5 of 10 attempts using a suitable technique.
twoStarDescription: Send a slow feed into one of two wide target zones on 6 of 10 attempts.
threeStarDescription: Complete a short sequence of controlled strikes from gentle, predictable feeds while staying balanced and within a clear area.

title: Swimming fundamentals
description: Build water confidence, basic floating and propulsion, and the ability to practise a chosen basic stroke in an appropriate swimming environment.
oneStarDescription: During a supervised beginner session, practise controlled exhalation, supported floating or body-position exercises chosen by a qualified instructor.
twoStarDescription: With instructor approval, travel a short pool distance using a taught basic stroke and return to the wall without panic.
threeStarDescription: In a supervised pool, complete a continuous 25-metre swim using a chosen basic stroke, then exit safely using the pool’s normal exit.

title: Trail running fundamentals
description: Run on suitable natural paths while scanning the terrain, adjusting stride and pace, and choosing safe footing on changing surfaces.
oneStarDescription: Complete a short run-walk on a wide, dry, familiar natural path, looking ahead and slowing before uneven sections.
twoStarDescription: Complete an easy loop with a few gentle changes of surface while staying in control and choosing stable footing.
threeStarDescription: Select an ability-appropriate marked trail, check conditions, plan an exit/turnaround option and complete it using deliberate pacing and terrain scanning.

title: Take notes for someone you accompany
description: Go with someone who asked you to, and write only what they want recorded.
oneStarDescription: Before you go, agree what you will write and what you will not.
twoStarDescription: Write the points they indicate, in their words as far as you can.
threeStarDescription: Give them the notes and delete or leave out anything they say is too private.

title: Agree how you will check in
description: Agree with someone when you will contact them and what silence means.
oneStarDescription: Propose a time and a channel.
twoStarDescription: Agree what you will do if they do not answer.
threeStarDescription: Send the check-in at the time, and follow the agreed step if there is no answer.

title: Agree a hand signal
description: Agree one hand signal and use it once at a distance where speech is hard.
oneStarDescription: Agree what one signal means before you separate.
twoStarDescription: Use it once, and have the other person do the agreed response.
threeStarDescription: If they do not respond, stop relying on it and use a closer method.

title: Agree a spot for a shared tool
description: Agree where a shared tool lives, and put it back once.
oneStarDescription: Propose a spot the people who use the tool can reach.
twoStarDescription: Agree the spot with at least one other user.
threeStarDescription: Use the tool and put it back, or say you left it out and then return it.
